headline: Houthi Missiles Strike Presidential Palace In Aden
standfirst: A missile attack on the Yemeni government headquarters has left five people dead.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Houthi forces fired missiles at the presidential palace in Aden. Witnesses reported six explosions.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Yemen has faced ongoing conflict between the recognized government and Houthi rebels for years.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Five people were killed in the attack. It highlights the continued instability in the region.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: The Saudi-led coalition is tracking dozens of recent Houthi attacks across the country.

caption:
Houthi rebels have launched a missile attack against the presidential palace located in the city of Aden.

The strike hit a complex used by Yemen's internationally recognized government. Authorities confirmed that five people died during the explosions.
